create.title: Create agent
create.subtitle: Start with a clear identity, then choose a model and capabilities.
create.identityDescription: Give this agent a durable, recognizable purpose.

blank.title: Blank agent
blank.description: Start from the safe default and customize every section.
blank.instructions: Fulfill the Agent purpose described in its name and description. Follow the configured capability, knowledge, memory, and safety policies.

support.title: Support triage
support.description: Classify requests, explain routing, and stay within configured tools.
support.instructions: Classify support requests, explain the selected queue, and ask for missing context. Use only configured capabilities and Knowledge sources.
support.welcome: Describe the support request you want me to triage.
support.goal: Classify support requests accurately with an explicit queue, owner, and routing reason.
support.trigger: A new customer support request arrives
support.success: Queue, owner, rationale, and missing information are explicit

knowledge.title: Knowledge guide
knowledge.description: Answer from authorized Datasets and make uncertainty explicit.
knowledge.instructions: Answer from the configured Knowledge sources. Cite retrieved evidence, distinguish evidence from inference, and say when the available sources are insufficient.
knowledge.welcome: What would you like to find in the workspace Knowledge sources?
knowledge.promptTwo: Find evidence for a process question
knowledge.goal: Answer from authorized knowledge with traceable evidence and a clear boundary between evidence and inference.
knowledge.trigger: A user asks a question that needs workspace knowledge
knowledge.success: Available evidence is cited and insufficient evidence is stated explicitly

memory.description: Control session context without embedding credentials or secrets in the Agent spec.

memory.credentialsTitle: Credentials are never stored in Agent specs
memory.credentialsDescription: MCP and Connector bindings reference server-owned credential principals and are re-authorized for every run.
memory.attachmentsValue: Allowed only when the server-resolved channel policy permits them
memory.retentionValue: Enforced by tenant policy; not stored as a browser credential
memory.toolApprovalValue: High-risk tools are blocked in Preview unless server policy explicitly allows them
memory.publicPolicyValue: Unavailable until a Version and channel policy are published

eval.description: Evaluate the exact saved Draft, inspect server evidence, and promote an immutable Version.

channels.description: Publish immutable Versions, manage release channels and Runtime API tokens, and roll back to prior versions.
channels.tokensLoadFailed: Could not read Runtime API tokens. Previously shown status is hidden until a fresh read succeeds.
channels.tokenOperationFailed: The token operation was not confirmed. Refresh to inspect the current status; the operation will not be repeated. A newly issued secret cannot be recovered from this list.
channels.tokenWriteConfirmed: The token operation was accepted, but its updated status could not be read. Refresh the list before making another change.
channels.tokenPermissionDenied: Permission to manage tokens was denied. Refresh to check your current access.
channels.tokenNewDecision: I have reviewed the status; allow a new action
channels.tokenNewDecisionHelp: Review the refreshed list before allowing another action. This does not retry the previous operation or recover a lost secret.
channels.tokenCopyFailed: Could not copy the token. Copy it manually before closing this dialog.
channels.copyTokenWarning: This raw token is displayed once and cannot be recovered.

release.ownerOnlyDescription: Editors and Viewers can inspect release evidence, but only an Owner can evaluate or publish.
release.rollbackOwnerOnly: Release history is read-only for this role. Only an Owner can roll back a channel.
release.saveFirstDescription: Evaluation is bound to an exact saved revision. Save or discard local changes before continuing.
release.noDatasetTitle: No production evaluation dataset is configured
release.noDatasetDescription: The default offline profile checks integrity, authorization, resources, secret safety, and release policy. It does not claim model quality.
release.providerFreeDescription: This server-owned profile performs deterministic release checks without calling a model. Model quality remains unevaluated unless an approved production profile is configured.
release.runDescription: The server will resolve revision {revision}, its exact spec, resources, and runtime fingerprints.
release.publicExpiryNotice: This public audience and expiry are frozen in the release evaluation.
release.publicExpiryRequired: Choose a future expiry before evaluating public access.
release.publicExpiryElapsed: This evaluation''s public expiry has passed. Run a new evaluation with a future expiry.
release.selectedRunHint: Optional: enter a successful live run ID from Eval. Verify its immutable Version and test set before linking it to this publication.
release.runAudienceHint: Linked model-quality runs are available for private and tenant releases.
release.runUnavailable: This run could not be loaded. Check its ID and access.
release.historyDescription: Every result is immutable and becomes stale when the resolved Draft or runtime fingerprints change.
release.modelQualityEvaluated: Model quality was evaluated by the configured server profile.
release.providerFreeScope: Model-free integrity checks only · model quality not evaluated
release.staleReasons: Current runtime no longer matches this evaluation
release.serverValidationPassed: Server validation passed for this exact candidate
release.authorizationRechecked: Resource authorization will be rechecked in the promotion transaction
release.noSecrets: Published specification contains references, never credentials or secrets
release.diffFailed: The server diff could not be loaded
release.promptLengthDiff: Prompt length: {before} → {after} characters; prompt text is not exposed here.
release.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this exact revision should be promoted.
release.sessionPinningDescription: Existing sessions stay on their pinned Version. Only new sessions resolve the current channel pointer.
release.publishSuccessDescription: Immutable Version v{version} is now the channel target; existing sessions remain pinned.
release.versionsDescription: Draft edits never mutate these records. Channel changes append audit events and preserve prior Versions.
release.noVersions: No immutable Version has been created.
release.pointerStable: Draft edits do not change this pointer.
release.evidenceImmutable: The request hash and Version link are append-only audit evidence.
release.noReleaseEvidence: No promotion event targets this Version.
release.rollbackRecheck: The server rechecks current authorization, resource health, and revocation before changing the pointer. The prior Version remains recoverable.

versionComparison.title: Compare saved versions
versionComparison.description: Inspect two immutable configurations before deciding whether to roll back.
versionComparison.boundary: The API may redact, omit or normalize saved values. Hidden values cannot be compared here. This review does not show current permissions, resolved runtime behavior, release audience or evaluation quality, and does not publish, roll back or run the Agent.
versionComparison.loading: Reading versions for the current Agent and account…
versionComparison.readError: Versions could not be read or their Agent/tenant identity could not be verified. Refresh to try the read again.
versionComparison.needTwo: Save at least two immutable versions to compare them. Draft revisions are not saved versions.
versionComparison.selectionUnavailable: A selected version is no longer in the current authorized response. Select again; no substitute was chosen.
versionComparison.hasChanges: {count, plural, one {{count} readable field differs.} other {{count} readable fields differ.}}
versionComparison.noChanges: No differences were found in the returned readable snapshots. Omitted or redacted values may still differ; this is not proof of identical stored configuration or quality.
versionComparison.omitted: Only known Studio fields are displayed. Returned opaque configuration is compared without printing its contents; values hidden by the API cannot be compared. No defaults are added locally. Missing values and list order describe the returned snapshots, not necessarily the original stored records.
versionComparison.absent: Not present in the returned snapshot
versionComparison.unavailable: Unavailable in the expected field format

deletionRecovery.title: Runtime data deletion receipt
deletionRecovery.retryDescription: This sends the same deletion request again and may perform unfinished destructive cleanup. It is not a read-only status check. The original Agent, scope, subject and request key stay fixed.
deletionRecovery.scopeNotice: This receipt is kept only in this page view. Save the identifiers before leaving. A failed or pending result can include completed side effects; continuing never means undoing earlier deletion.
deletionRecovery.refreshFailed: The deletion receipt was received, but analytics or audit refresh failed. The receipt remains available.
